patterns.note: Dark mode aesthetic with high-contrast light text and a consistent use of full-width sections that center content, often within rounded container cards.
A clear typographic hierarchy uses large, bold, sans-serif headings for impact, paired with a more neutral sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for sub-sections.
The primary palette is dominated by a deep charcoal background, pure white text, and subtle accents of soft pink/peach and muted red for highlights and calls to action.

The initial hero content scrolls away, revealing a key interactive element (video input field and CTA button) that animates into a prominent, centered position as the user scrolls down, effectively transforming the hero's primary interaction point.
Feature sections frequently employ a two-column layout with an image/visual on one side and descriptive text on the other, alternating sides down the page.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that remains visible throughout the scroll. The hero section's primary content scrolls out of view, while a core interactive element from the hero animates and re-centers itself as a persistent call to action, using a combination of CSS transforms and opacity changes. Subsequent content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide effect as they enter the viewport, likely orchestrated with a JavaScript animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger or similar CSS keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual anchors, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, labels for categorization and clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons, input fields, and content cards feature a soft, consistent corner rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; generous vertical spacing between major sections provides an airy feel, while content within cards maintains a comfortable density.

standout: The site's standout feature is its dynamic hero section, where the primary call to action (a video input field) transforms and re-centers itself as the user scrolls, maintaining interactive prominence beyond the initial hero view. This, combined with a sleek dark mode and video-centric examples, creates a highly engaging and product-focused experience.
